steps.note: [everyhelp wall 2026-10-06/07] document-start via recipe `taobao-block-everyhelp` (fetch/XHR reject). [everyhelp wall 2026-10-06/07] the widget's getWidgetVersion answers 200 while its Set-Cookie deletes unb/sn/uss server-side — session revocation with no error surface. Any taobao page may load it, so this session gets the same fetch/XHR block the publish flow carries; instance-level AGINXBROWSER_INIT_SCRIPT covers the rest when mounted.
first document load after everyhelp recipe mounted (create is bare — kills unsigned first-boot race).

login.jhtml 302s to havanaone/login.htm; the QR canvas is the page's only canvas, rendered ~0.8s after doc start (qrCode/generate.do fires at ~0.17s) — no tab click needed, it sits beside the password/SMS form. Direct URL skips the 9.8s www.taobao.com front
cropped to the QR element — what the human scans (淘宝 App 扫一扫). qrCode/query.do polls scan state from ~0.8s automatically
on scan+confirm havana navigates off login.taobao.com (mid-login hops stay on that host, so this fires on the real landing). Cookie lands on .taobao.com — any taobao session can import it afterwards

logged-in landing evidence; redirectURL pins the landing to www.taobao.com so the nick anchor is meaningful there (nick:true = logged in, false = landed elsewhere or logged out — re-check on www before retrying; do NOT probe i.taobao.com my_taobao: no nick anchor on that page + bounces to havana = false negative, 2026-10-07 watch lesson). Session stays alive after the flow — session_id on the receipt is the export handle (GET /session/:id/cookies, /storage)

note_live_qr: Hand the person receipt.live_qr (GET /session/<id>/qr/live on this engine): a page that re-reads the code the login page shows every second. Never send a static screenshot — it expires before the phone is in hand.
